{{Top|canon=Clone trooper flight crew}}
[[File:CloneFlightCrew-TCWCE.png|thumb|right|150px|A flight crew clone]]
'''Clone flight crews''' were [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that were trained to maintain [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]]. Many often served onboard fleets and large cruisers such as [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]]. The flight crew was also in charge of [[Fuel/Legends|fueling]] and repairing any vessel that needed it after a battle, they were also responsible for unloading [[astromech droid]]s for servicing.<ref name="TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> 

Flight crew clones, such as [[Switch (clone trooper)|Switch]], were often called "soft-shells" by their combat clone trooper brothers.<ref name="Republic Heroes">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>
